protocol: A01 immediate repeated construction in the same loaded application; normal exact-seed/replay UI
corpusRule: Frozen 77-root order; map each root to its already accepted canonical candidate from retained cold77. No reselection or new random corpus.
whyExactReplay: New Board intentionally avoids duplicate roots/boards. An ordinary exact/replay request reconstructs the same accepted identity through normal admission and instance-owned production cache.
firstAttemptRole: Recorded unprimed construction/setup for this pair; not a rerun or replacement of the accepted cold77 gate.
warmRole: Immediate repeated normal exact-seed construction in the same document; no reload, cache clearing or private verifier route.
measure: Browser monotonic time from ordinary public action dispatch to terminal player view; public progress samples retain last observed stage and lower-bound work counts. Unsupported internal terminal reason/counters remain explicit.

runtimeEstimate.method: Sum retained cold wall plus each job wall less diagnostic-proof stage time; estimate only, not measured warm results. Add startup/input/cleanup/headroom before coordinating.
runtimeEstimate.pilot: First three frozen rows (20/30/40 boundaries) counted once in the corpus; validate observations and projection before continuing.

resourceCoordination: Parent coordination required before measurements because Takeoff/Price Scraper and LocalDots share this Windows host. No quiet-machine timing claim during competing builds.
historicDisposition: Original release remains BLOCKED; later verified absence supports then-present cleanup only. Original91.616s failure and six missing scratch inventories remain unresolved historical risks.
distributionRule: Use existing scripts/a01.py percentile for passed warm public admission times (ceil milliseconds); retain every priming/repeat, nonpass, censored/NOT_RUN row and last observed stage separately. No new p95 acceptance target.
knownMetricLimits: These are normal exact/replay requests for the boards accepted by each frozen root; they are not repeated New Board candidate searches.
Production D01 may reuse value-only proof while rebuilding the board; exact internal cache counters and final work counts are not public and remain null.
Public-action-to-terminal-view timing includes UI scheduling; it is not relabeled GenerationJob.elapsedMs.
The last sampled public stage is not a fabricated exact internal rejection stage.
A failed priming attempt does not establish a warm cache, even if its subsequent repeat succeeds.
